section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1999
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1999 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.7.6 Although break-up of total Government and Private vehicles is not available, it is interesting to note that 94.8 percent victims of ‘Truck/Lorry’, 64.9 percent of ‘Buses’, 93.6 percent of ‘Tempo/Vans’, 94.5% of ‘Jeeps’ and 93.0 percent of cars, involved in accidents, were traveling in private vehicles.
